main_body: octagonal wooden platform with a small music stand on top
top_band: tan platform surface from row 12 to row 24, with a gold bevel edge at row 25
evidence: The main body is the wooden podium platform: reading down a central column beside the stand base, rows 12-24 are the horizontal top surface (tan), row 25 is a distinct gold rim/front edge line, and rows 26-30 are the vertical front face in three angled facets shaded from light to dark brown.

style.evidence: The entire top surface of the podium (roughly 20x12 pixels) is a single flat unshaded tan colour with zero wood grain, plank lines or speckle, and the front facets are solid flat blocks of colour. Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, which have wood grain dots, stone shading and rich per-tile colour variation, this piece is largely flat fills.
